d:
Tsuyatsuya-sensei's "-with me?- Koko de wa Nai Dokoka he" with 2x upscale and text cleaned up.
I’ve removed all the dialogues, chapter titles, and most (or all—I don’t remember) of the characters’ inner thoughts. I’ve also made some minor redraws where necessary.
I really hope my work makes it easier for someone to translate this tankōbon.
